title: The Ninety Reforged
description: This mod will add different types of materials, such as copper, tin, and tungsten. It will also add new trees and biomes.
body:
mitlu_ presents The Ninety Reforged mod! This is a sequel to the previous two mods: The Ninety and The Ninety Retake.
# 📌 What's in the Mod
The Ninety Reforged gives you a lot of useful items that either didn't exist in previous mods or have been improved in this mod!

There are some things in this mod:
- A whole new dimension: it can be obtained by building a portal and collecting another item to light it.
- There are a lot of new blocks, items, and various tools and armor.
- 6 new utility blocks: Grador, Drill, Packer, Autonomous Block Teleporter, Generators, Tree Generator.
- 4 material tiers: Tin, Bronze, Thungsten, and Ruby.
- New mobs that can be found in all dimensions.
- Entire chains of functional blocks that can be transformed into an entire automated factory.
- A new type of tools: movers.
- 2 new biomes with their own tree species.
# 📚 Getting Started
1 thing you will notice when you play: Copper is no longer useless. It can be used for saving purposes, for crafting tools and armor.

![Copper Armor](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e3c872f4f506ace92744ba9cc99241829c73a07c_0.webp)

After that, you will most likely be killed by new mobs: watchers.
More specifically, they are a separate rank of mobs. There are 3 types of watchers: classic (tall, fast, and normal damage), short (short, fast, and high damage), and grand watchers (very tall, fast, and very high damage).

After that, you will be afraid of them, but there is a fact that you will not want to go to the cave. But how to get different ores? Use a new functional block: the drill. To work, you need a generator. The generator can be easily crafted, and for its crafting you need batteries. For them, you need redstone.

# 📦 Factory
Just by using drills, you can pack them in 4 sides with Packer. After that, you can break the packed blocks through the "Grador" block.

![Easiest automatic factory](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8f64f81b42eaeaf0da05cf8695daee9b266ae144_0.webp)
